accessibility.evidence: Playwright verified keyboard skip-link focus, visible focus entry, semantic headings, reduced-motion scroll behavior, and axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA checks for homepage plus light/dark get-started docs at both viewports. Fixed inline-link distinction and light/dark contrast failures. This is automated coverage, not a full assistive-technology audit.

responsive.evidence: Rendered screenshots inspected at 390x844 and 1440x900. No document horizontal overflow. Navigation, paragraphs and CTA wrap; screenshots retain aspect ratio and link to full-size images. Mobile docs drawer opens and follows a page link.

loading.evidence: Docs search renders an initializing message before its local worker/index is ready; browser tests await the ready prompt before querying.

empty.evidence: Unmatched docs search visibly reports No matching documents and accepts a replacement query.

error.evidence: Unknown marketing and docs URLs return HTTP 404; the custom not-found page offers home and documentation links.

partial.reason: Marketing and docs are static pages with no partial remote dataset. Screenshots have descriptive alt text and fixed dimensions.

success.evidence: Primary CTA opens source setup; docs search finds and opens the JSON guide; internal pages and linked local assets return expected content.

permission.reason: The public site has no account, authenticated area, database connection, or permission-gated action.
